description: Arrival order of the synthetic Cinderline press-line count files. Each file is copied to a staging directory, stamped with its landing time as the file modification time, then moved (renamed) into the watched landing directory, so the file source sees it appear atomically and orders it by that time.

arrivals.note: Six on-time counts from lines L1 and L2.
e007 and e008 arrive after later events; e008 (09:05:00) is older than the 09:07:40 watermark in force when it is read, but its window is still open.
e011 (09:03:00) arrives 25 minutes after it happened, after its 09:00-09:10 window was finalized in the sequential run; L3 appears for the first time.
e016 (09:21:00) is late but inside the open 09:20-09:30 window; e015 moves the watermark past 09:30.
Arrives after the crash and restart; e018 lands in the open 09:30-09:40 window and e017 closes it.
